sources.title: Open Sourcing Roblox PII Classifier: Our Approach to AI PII Detection ...
sources.snippet: The version of our PII model that we're open sourcing today has a 98% recall of potential PII conversations in English text 1 on Roblox. The model has also achieved an F1 score of 94% on our production data, outperforming other state-of-the-art safety models, like LlamaGuard v3 8B (28%) and Piiranha NER (14%).
